description: Estimate usable and rentable office square feet from headcount, growth, desk sharing, rooms, circulation and load factor. Preliminary planning estimate only. The architect's test fit, the building drawings and the permit set govern the actual layout.

area_large_meeting_sqft.description: Area per large meeting room. Unit: sq ft each.

area_medium_meeting_sqft.description: Area per medium meeting room. Unit: sq ft each.

area_private_office_sqft.description: Area per private office. Unit: sq ft each.

area_small_meeting_sqft.description: Area per small meeting room. Unit: sq ft each.

area_storage_sqft.description: Storage or server room area. Unit: sq ft.

area_workstation_sqft.description: Area per workstation. Unit: sq ft each.

circulation_pct.description: Circulation allowance added to the components. Unit: percent.

growth_pct.description: Expected growth over the lease term. Unit: percent.

kitchen_sqft.description: Kitchen and break area. 0 for none. Unit: sq ft.

large_meeting_rooms.description: Large meeting rooms (12 or more people). Unit: count.

load_factor_pct.description: Load factor: rentable = usable x (1 + load factor). Unit: percent.

medium_meeting_rooms.description: Medium meeting rooms (up to 8 people). Unit: count.

pattern.description: Work pattern. Sets the default desk sharing ratio.

people_per_desk.description: Desk sharing ratio, 1 or more. Default follows pattern: office 1, hybrid 1.5, remote 3. Unit: people per desk.

small_meeting_rooms.description: Small meeting rooms (up to 4 people). Unit: count.

storage_room.description: Include a storage or server room.

name: office_space_calculator
